title: Rename shared corpus documentation and closure
summary: Expanded the existing rename bad-case corpus to 30 cases and made every active applicable case run through Python rename, real PowerShell preview, and TV Queue parsing/snapshot checks. Corrected rename inventories and testing documentation, regenerated affected navigation artifacts, and closed cross-runtime regressions exposed by the shared corpus.
reason: The previous fixtures and documentation did not consistently gate range endpoints, parse modes, Queue ordering/block state, policy overrides, or cross-runtime behavior. Generic folder names also masked filename-derived show identity in the SubsPlease and OVA cases.
behavior_before: Rename edge cases were split across partially enforced expectations, PowerShell and Queue checks did not consume the full active corpus, and stale inventories overstated or misdescribed coverage.
behavior_after: One JSONL corpus gates Python, PowerShell preview, and Queue behavior for uploader revisions, canonical and rejected ranges, high episode numbers, special/ordinal seasons, metadata tails, policy overrides, legitimate numeric and metadata-like title words, and Queue reliability/order evidence.
manual_validation: Invoke-PipelineQueueEngineChecks.ps1: passed with the expanded 30-case corpus.
Rename readiness and browser smokes: passed (1 test each).
Release self-test with -SkipEndToEndSmoke: passed, including tool integration; the requested end-to-end media smoke was skipped and the source/development release-manifest warning was informational.
Generated summary, project/dependency, feature-map, and duplicate-test guards: passed after regeneration.
Ruff and git diff whitespace checks: passed.
rollback_plan: Revert the Packet 4 corpus, harness, documentation, generated-context changes, and the narrow PowerShell parity corrections together; retain completed policy and identity work from Packets 1-3.
notes:
Packet 4 extends the existing JSONL authority to 30 cases and closes Python, PowerShell-preview, Queue-snapshot, documentation, and schema-validation gaps.
Regenerated every in-scope Packet 4 navigation summary.
Regenerated project/dependency indexes and duplicate-test report after corpus/test expansion.
Regenerated feature/file map after project-index expansion.
Added Packet 4 generated summary before final release validation.
